description: Read the exact generated TypeScript interface or type declaration from the generated types file. Supports optional pagination for large types.

api.description: API specification source (<name>=<url>, direct URL, or name to filter).

apiFile.description: Direct local file path to OpenAPI specification.

apiUrl.description: Direct URL to OpenAPI specification (JSON or YAML).

authHeader.description: Custom header in 'Key: Value' format (used with authType: custom).

authIn.description: API key location: header or query (used with authType: apiKey).

authName.description: API key header or query param name (default: X-API-Key).

authToken.description: Bearer token or password value / env var reference for auth.

authType.description: Spec authentication type (bearer, basic, apiKey, custom).

configJson.description: Raw JSON string defining an openapi-sync configuration.

folder.description: Output directory for generated files (default: '' project root).

maxLines.description: Maximum number of lines to return.

offset.description: Starting line offset (0-indexed) for paginating large type definitions.

server.description: Default server index or base URL override.

sharedPaths.description: Group endpoints by URL path and extract shared path functions and BASE_URL in endpoints.ts.

typeName.description: The exported interface or type name to read.

name: openapi_sync_read_generated_type
